build_masked_lm_datasets: build source and target datasets for masked language modeling using MaskTokensDataset.apply_mask
create_mask_tokens_dataset: create a MaskTokensDataset wrapper that masks tokens with configurable probability and replacement strategy
test_mask_whole_words: test the MaskTokensDataset with mask_whole_words to mask entire words instead of individual tokens
review_mask_prob_config: review the MaskTokensDataset mask_prob, leave_unmasked_prob, and random_token_prob configuration parameters
refactor_mask_multiple_length: refactor the MaskTokensDataset to use mask_multiple_length and mask_stdev for vq-wav2vec style multiple masking
